nodes.name: Gmail Send
nodes.notes: OAuth scope must be gmail.send ONLY. Authenticated mailbox is the From identity. onError continueErrorOutput → Revert Claim / Pause on Send Error. Also pair Error Workflow stub invoice-chase-send-error.json for workflow-level failures.

parameters.content:
## Escalating Invoice Chase (MVP)

Stages: **0** polite (due day) → **3** firm → **7** final.

**Claim-before-send:** `Claim Stage` writes `LastStageSent` + `LastSentAt` before Gmail.

**STOP / opt-out (product control):** `Status=Paid` or `Paused` skips all stages; Notes matching `\bSTOP\b` also skip. Reply-STOP + unsubscribe webhook set `Paused`.

**Security:** concurrency=1; strip CR/LF + validate email before send; saveData*Execution=none; send-error → revert claim / Paused.

Replace `REPLACE_WITH_SPREADSHEET_ID`, attach **Google Sheets account** and **Gmail account** (`gmail.send` only).

nodes.name: Revert Claim (on send error)
nodes.notes: Clears LastStageSent/LastSentAt after Gmail failure so the stage can retry. Alternative ops policy: set Status=Paused instead (see error-workflow stub).
